documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On October 30, 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Board Meeting Intimation for Meeting To Be Held On October 30, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Vadilal Industries reported 3% reported growth (13% adjusted) in consolidated revenues for FY19 and started FY20 with 13% revenue growth in Q1. International business crossed the $20 million milestone in FY19 following 54% revenue growth, driven by demand within the U.S. Indian diaspora. Management expects to incur Rs. 30-35 crore in capital expenditure in FY20 and aims to add 10,000 sales outlets.

guidance.claim: Management expects Vadilal to deliver double-digit growth with margin expansion driven by higher international contribution.
guidance.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: Vadilal expects strong contribution from sales for the upcoming summer season due to secured supply arrangements.
guidance.quote: Having already closed key supply arrangements for the upcoming summer season, we have clear visibility of input costs and expect strong contribution from sales.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates another good year in FY20 by leveraging the Vadilal brand.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

guidance.claim: Vadilal Industries maintains a positive business outlook driven by better consumption environment and growth in international business.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we maintain our positive business outlook – better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector and continued traction in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic ice cream consumption in core markets faced weakness in Q4 FY19 due to severe weather extending winter through late March.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues grew by 54% in FY19 to exceed $20 million, supported by demand from the Indian diaspora in the U.S. and other markets.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues continued to deliver encouraging expansion to cross the $ 20 million milestone, on the back of 54% revenue growth during FY19.

demand_outlook.claim: Vadilal started FY20 with double-digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue growth in international business.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Vadilal delivered around 27% growth in revenues in Q3 FY19, with domestic business growing 12% and international business growing 71%.
demand_outlook.quote: During Q3, we have delivered ~27% growth in revenues – including 12% growth in the domestic business and 71% growth in the international business that continues to expand rapidly from a low base.

demand_outlook.claim: Vadilal expanded ice cream volumes by 6.9% during Q2 FY19, supported by domestic and international volume growth.
demand_outlook.quote: During Q2, we have continued our strong business momentum to expand ice cream volumes by 6.9%, driven by 6% domestic volume growth and 37% expansion in the international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Vadilal products reach 55,000 retail outlets across 26 states in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Currently, Vadilal products reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states and we remain committed to expand the network judiciously.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues accounted for 32% of total turnover in Q2 FY19.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues contributed 32% to the turnover during Q2 and continue to expand rapidly with Vadilal ice cream and processed foods products finding positive demand pull from the Indian diaspora in the US and other key markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Vadilal expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

capex_expansion.claim: Estimated capital expenditure for FY19 is approximately Rs. 35 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

capex_expansion.claim: Vadilal anticipates no major capital expenditure on capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points in FY19 due to volume growth, benign raw material costs, and higher international sales.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: People resource costs grew significantly last year, largely from U.S. operations which now employ over 50 people.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

margins_costs.claim: The company will look to increase prices in the second half of the year due to higher milk prices.
margins_costs.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 FY19 from 40% in Q3 FY18.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have continued to expand – gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: For the first nine months of FY19, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.
margins_costs.quote: On nine month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin increased by over ~1,000 bps in Q2 FY19.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have improved significantly during the quarter – gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Subdued raw material prices for the upcoming season are expected to benefit company margins.
margins_costs.quote: We have been engaging with raw material suppliers for the next season and prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

orders_capacity.claim: Vadilal expanded its production capacity from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated for capacity enhancement.
orders_capacity.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

orders_capacity.claim: Production relies on automated processes untouched by hand, with manual intervention limited to packaging.
orders_capacity.quote: Current production on automated processes “untouched by hand”, manual intervention only at packaging stage

orders_capacity.claim: The Bareilly plant in Uttar Pradesh has an ice cream production capacity of 150,000 liters per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh 150,000 liters per day Ice cream ISO-22000:2005

orders_capacity.claim: The Dharampur plant in Gujarat has a processed foods production capacity of 33,000 kgs per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Dharampur, Gujarat 33,000 kgs per day Processed foods ISO-22000:2005 and BRC : Issue 6

capital_allocation.claim: Vadilal reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long-tenure loans and reduce interest costs.
capital_allocation.quote: Reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduced cost of debt

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to use operational surplus to restructure debt and improve working capital management.
capital_allocation.quote: Leveraging surplus generated by operations to rationalize/ restructure debt and improve working capital management

risks_headwinds.claim: Milk prices are currently at higher levels.
risks_headwinds.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic ice cream sales in core markets were impacted in Q4 by severe extended winter weather.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic business growth was temporarily affected by recent operating environment changes and consumption spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

management_commitments.claim: The company expects capital expenditure to be between Rs. 30-35 crore during FY20.
management_commitments.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

management_commitments.claim: Management will look to increase prices in the second half of the year due to higher milk costs.
management_commitments.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

management_commitments.claim: Vadilal sees another good year in FY20 as it leverages its brand for growth.
management_commitments.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

management_commitments.claim: Vadilal estimated its capex for FY19 at approximately Rs. 35 crore.
management_commitments.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
